meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: 网页与数字界面设计师在构建Web页面或应用组件时，若受够了千篇一律的AI味设计，请用此技能。一键生成极具视觉冲击力、排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码，告别平庸，打造令人难忘的高品质数字界面。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果受够了千篇一律的AI味网页设计
copy.tagline_en: Generate production-grade frontend code with unique typography and stunning motion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of generic AI-look web designs

howto.what: 让它先定下一个明确的视觉方向（如极简、复古未来、编辑杂志风等），再写出可运行的前端代码（HTML/CSS/JS、React、Vue 等）：字体、配色、动效、版式都围绕这个方向精修，避免常见的 AI 味设计。
howto.when: 当你要做网页、页面或应用组件，又不想要千篇一律的 AI 味设计时，它会先做设计定调，再动手写代码。

say.text: 帮我做一个产品落地页，走编辑杂志式的排版风格
say.note: 先定设计方向，再输出可运行代码

say.text: 用 React 写一个深色主题的仪表盘界面，要不对称布局
say.note: 会按该方向选字体、配色与动效

say.text: 重做这个页面的字体和配色，别用 Inter 和紫色渐变
say.note: 换成更具个性的字体与配色

howto.what_en: Claude first commits to a bold aesthetic direction, then writes working frontend code (HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue) with distinctive fonts, color, motion, layout and textures instead of generic AI-looking design.
howto.when_en: Use it when building a web page, screen or app component and you don't want the same generic AI look; it settles the design direction before writing code.

say_en.text: Build a product landing page with an editorial magazine layout
say_en.note: Sets a direction, then writes runnable code

say_en.text: Write a dark-theme React dashboard with an asymmetric layout
say_en.note: Picks fonts, colors and motion to match

say_en.text: Rework this page's fonts and colors, skip Inter and purple gradients
say_en.note: Swaps in more distinctive type and palette
